## Overview

A short introduction to R. We work on some R basics that you'll need for data
manipulation and visualisation. The session is geared towards everyone who has
never used R before, and towards anyone who'd like to refresh their memory.

## Prerequisites

You are welcome to just come and listen. If you want to code along, please bring
your own laptop with **R** and **RStudio** installed.
